metadata_system.name: Cookie Metadata
metadata_system.description: HTTP cookies as defined in RFC 6265 plus the modern attributes from RFC 6265bis-style draft progress (SameSite, Partitioned, Priority, etc.). Stored client-side in browser, transmitted via Cookie/Set-Cookie HTTP headers.

attribute.name: Name
attribute.description: Cookie name (no =, ;, control chars)

attribute.name: Value
attribute.description: Cookie value

attribute.name: Expires
attribute.description: Absolute expiration (deprecated, use Max-Age)

attribute.name: Max-Age
attribute.description: Lifetime in seconds; 0 or negative = expire now

attribute.name: Domain
attribute.description: Hosts allowed to receive cookie. Defaults to requesting host (host-only). Cannot be set to public suffix or unrelated domain.

attribute.name: Path
attribute.description: URL path prefix required for cookie to be sent

attribute.name: Secure
attribute.description: Only transmit over TLS (HTTPS)

attribute.name: HttpOnly
attribute.description: Inaccessible to JavaScript (document.cookie). Mitigates XSS.

attribute.name: SameSite
attribute.description: Cross-site behavior

values.value: Sent on top-level navigation; default in modern browsers
Sent on all requests; requires Secure

attribute.name: Partitioned
attribute.description: CHIPS — partition cookie storage by top-level site (RFC draft)

attribute.name: Priority
attribute.description: Eviction priority (Chromium extension)

attribute.name: Set-Cookie header
attribute.description: Server sets cookie via response header

attribute.name: Cookie header
attribute.description: Browser sends cookies via request header

attribute.name: __Secure- prefix
attribute.description: Forces Secure attribute

attribute.name: __Host- prefix
attribute.description: Forces Secure + no Domain (host-only) + Path=/

attribute.name: Cookie Jar (RFC 6265bis)
attribute.description: Browser data store: name/value/domain/path/expires/last-access/creation-time/persistent flag/host-only flag/secure-only flag/http-only flag/SameSite

attribute.name: Cookie Length Limits
attribute.description: Per cookie: name+value ≤ 4096 bytes typical; per domain: 50-180 cookies typical; total: 3000-7000+ varies

attribute.name: Third-Party Cookies
attribute.description: Set by domain different from top-level — being deprecated in major browsers (Safari ITP, Firefox ETP, Chrome Privacy Sandbox)

attribute.name: Browser Storage Locations
attribute.description: Chrome: SQLite at ~/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome/<Profile>/Cookies; Firefox: cookies.sqlite; Edge: similar to Chrome; Safari: Cookies.binarycookies

attribute.name: Cookie database forensic value
attribute.description: Last access time, creation time, host-only flag, secure flag — all recoverable from browser cookie SQLite
